why.help: One sentence, in your own words. It will guide everything else.

strategyInputs.heading: Your way of communicating is derived from two deliverables
strategyInputs.subtitle: It cannot be made up: the business plan states what you sell and to whom, the financial forecast gives your prices and your means. Without them the strategy would describe a brand, not your business — and everything that follows, plans and visuals, would inherit that mistake.
strategyInputs.illustrationAlt: Two deliverables feed the brand compass; without them the needle has no direction.

businessPlan.label: Business plan
businessPlan.effect: It provides the positioning, the market and the competition — enough to ground an angle that truly sets you apart.

finance.label: Financial forecast
finance.effect: It provides your prices and your communication budget — enough to propose channels you can actually fund.
